steps.name: circuit-breaker-core
steps.summary: Added gateway/resilience/circuit_breaker.py -- Redis-backed, provider-agnostic breaker state machine with `class BreakerState(str, Enum)` (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN), `class BreakerDecision(BaseModel)` (allowed, is_probe), and `async def check_breaker(redis: Redis, provider: str, config: CircuitBreakerConfig) -> BreakerDecision`, `async def record_success(redis: Redis, provider: str, was_probe: bool) -> None`, `async def record_failure(redis: Redis, provider: str, was_probe: bool, config: CircuitBreakerConfig) -> None`; Redis keys extend TRD SS4.2 with `breaker:{provider}:opened_at` (cooldown-elapsed timestamp via Redis TIME) and `breaker:{provider}:probe_claimed` (TTL=60s single-probe-winner marker), all transitions atomic via Lua (EVAL) and best-effort logged to `circuit_breaker_history`; amended docs/ADR.md ADR-010 with a Superseded subsection documenting the in-process -> Redis-backed reversal.

steps.name: fallback-retry-nonstreaming
steps.summary: Added gateway/resilience/fallback.py's `resolve_fallback_chain(provider, model, config) -> list[tuple[str, str]]` (pure, degrade-from-position); gateway/providers/registry.py's `get_adapter_for_provider(provider, config) -> ProviderAdapter` (reuses _get_adapter cache); gateway/resilience/orchestrator.py's `resolve_with_resilience(primary_provider: str, primary_model: str, request: ChatCompletionRequest, config: GatewayConfig, redis: Redis, attempt: Callable[[str, ProviderAdapter, ChatCompletionRequest], Awaitable[T]]) -> tuple[str, str, T]` (generic breaker-check -> retry-primary(3x via tenacity)/1-attempt-fallback-or-probe -> record_success/record_failure walk, reusable as-is by step 2's streaming attempt) and its non-streaming wrapper `call_with_resilience(request, provider, model, adapter, config, redis) -> tuple[str, ChatCompletionResponse]`; wired into routes.py's non-streaming branch, fixing `_record_spend` to take an explicit provider param so cost/spend-ledger writes use the serving provider (which may be a fallback) rather than the originally-resolved one; added tenacity>=9 to pyproject.toml deps (uv lock/sync run). All AC tests (tests/test_fallback.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py, tests/test_routing.py) plus full existing suite (181 tests) pass; ruff clean.

steps.name: fallback-retry-streaming
steps.summary: Changed gateway/streaming.py's `stream_chat_completion(chunks: AsyncIterator[ChatCompletionChunk], first_chunk: ChatCompletionChunk, request, on_complete=None)` -- stream establishment moved to the caller, first_chunk and the rest of `chunks` now flow through one shared per-chunk code path (`_consume`), tee/assemble/mid-stream-fault behavior unchanged; added `resolve_streaming_start(primary_provider, primary_model, request, config, redis) -> tuple[serving_provider, serving_model, chunks, first_chunk]` to gateway/resilience/orchestrator.py, a thin `attempt` callable (opens `adapter.chat_completion_stream` + pulls one item via `__anext__()`) wired straight into step 1's `resolve_with_resilience` with zero duplicated retry/fallback/breaker logic; wired into routes.py's streaming branch so `resolve_streaming_start` runs before `StreamingResponse` is constructed -- a pre-first-chunk failure across the whole primary+fallback chain now raises `RetryableProviderError`/`NonRetryableProviderError` into the same 503/502 handling the non-streaming branch already uses, instead of the old fake-200-with-error-chunk behavior (only a fault *after* the first chunk still falls through to that path, per ADR-009); `_on_complete`'s reconcile_tpm/_record_spend now use the returned `serving_provider`, matching step 1's non-streaming fix. Updated every direct `stream_chat_completion` caller in tests/test_streaming.py to the new signature; added resolve_streaming_start unit tests (fallback-on-open-failure, exhaustion-raises-last-error) to tests/test_orchestrator.py and route-level tests (fallback succeeds with 200, all-candidates-fail returns 503, fallback-served spend recorded against serving provider) to tests/test_streaming.py. Full suite (186 tests) passes; ruff clean.
